purpose: Teach: 環境庁/窒素/憲章/圧勝/疑念/塩素/至福/皇族

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、環境庁基準の院内空気質を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, we manage hospital air quality to environmental agency standards across the entire medical team.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Clinical but not cold. Even pacing, steady breath control. Brief pause after the name—professional respect, not warmth.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、麻酔ガスの窒素濃度を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Yes—we monitor anesthetic gas nitrogen levels as part of our standard team protocol.
lines.style: Continuation of thought, same measured tone. Slightly lower in the register—routine affirmation. No emphasis, no elaboration. Matter-of-fact breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療憲章の倫理を、貴院、徹底されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does uphold the ethical standards of the medical charter thoroughly, doesn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine but careful admiration. Slight lift at the end—a real question beneath the statement. Respectful, thoughtful pacing. Not flattery, observation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、治療効果が圧勝的に出た事例も医療チームで共有します
lines.en: Yes—we share successful treatment outcomes across the team, and those results speak clearly.
lines.style: Calm precision. Light emphasis on 'share' and 'clearly'—evidence of conviction. Steady, unhurried. The voice of someone who has seen results and trusts data.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者の疑念を、貴院、解消されますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital really does resolve patients' doubts and concerns, doesn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Ren is connecting pieces aloud—almost to himself. Respectful but genuine curiosity. Slight trailing-off, as if waiting for Doctor to confirm his understanding.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、消毒の塩素濃度を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes—we maintain disinfection chlorine levels under careful team management.
lines.style: Return to clinical precision. Slightly lower energy, routine protocol. Steady, measured breath. The tone of someone moving through a checklist with genuine care behind it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者の至福を支える緩和ケアを、貴院、ご提供ですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does provide that kind of palliative care—supporting patient comfort and peace, doesn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Warmth emerging beneath the respect. Ren's admiration deepens. Slower, more deliberate pacing. Soft landing on 'peace'—he's moved by what he's hearing, not just impressed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、皇族の方々の医療も医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes—our medical team handles care for members of the Imperial family as well.
lines.style: Quiet weight added to this statement. Slight pause before delivery. Even tone, but the gravity is unmissable. Close, almost intimate in its discretion. Final word lands softly, with appropriate reverence.
